Solaiman (Md) alias Soleman and others ----- Appellants
Vs. 
State ----- Respondent
full_judgment: 10. PW 1 (the informant) deposed to the effect that on 19-9-86 at about 9-00 AM, his father the deceased Abu Jafar Ali Sarker along with his brother Rabbani went to the land at plot No. 506 for spreading urea fertilizer. At about 10-00/10-30 AM when the PW was working in the land adjacent to said plot No. 506, accused Abdul Jabbar, Soleman Ali, Abdul Matin, Azizur, Nurul Islam, Ohed Ali, Rahim Uddin, Alim Uddin, Tota, Aftabuddin, Abdus Samad @ Abul, Kasem Ali and Jafar Ali being armed with deadly weapons trespassed into their land. Accused Abdul Jabbar started rebuking his father in filthy language and when his father protested, accused Jabbar ordered other accused persons to finish him. Then accused Soleman gave a dagger blow on the left side of the head and the left arm of this father. Accused Nurul Islam inflicted "Chhura" blow below the left shoulder of his father and the fingers of the left hand as well causing the finger to hang. When his younger brother raised cry, the PW who was working in the adjacent plot of the place of occurrence rushed to the spot, accused Azizur gave a dagger blow on the finger of the left hand of the PW causing one of his finger to be almost severed. Accused Ohed Ali, Aftab Ali, Alimuddin, Rahimuddin, Abul Hossain @ Abdus Samad, Kashem Ali, Abul, Jafar Ali and Abdul Matin assaulted his brother on various parts of his body. These accused persons also assaulted his father. Hearing the cry of the PW, witnesses, namely, Abdus Samad (PW 5) Abdul Aziz, Abdul Hamid (PW 3) and another Hamid and others came to the place of occurrence and then the accused persons fled away with arms. The father of the PW was admitted in Mahipur Hospital at Panchbibi, but his condition having deteriorated he was shifted to Rajshahi Medical College Hospital where he died on 26-9-86. The PW and his brother was treated at Osmanpur. This PW further deposed that the first information report was lodged on 22-9-86, that is, before the death of his father. This PW further deposed that the land on which 'maramari' took place was purchased by them from accused Abdul Jabbar and his mother Pannitannessa in 1958 and their names have duly been recorded in the Khatian. This PW proved the first information report as Exhibit '1' and his signature therein as, Exhibit 1(1), copy of the deed executed by Abdul Jabbar, as Exhibit 2, certified copy of the deed dated 22-8-58, as Exhibit 3, certified copy of the CS Khatian as Exhibit 4 and the latest khatian as Exhibit 5. This PW was cross-examined by the defence in extenso. And although in cross-examination this PW admitted the fact of getting decree in the suit filed by the wife of Solaiman and the fact of other litigations between the parties, yet the fact that no occurrence took place on the case plot on the date and time was not denied by the defence, rather the defence suggested that a 'maramari' took place on the case land and nobody saw who assaulted whom.
